    MultiplicativeBasisDeformations.IndSkeleton.meshWalk_isFreeGroup

    Lemma 4.2 for the Auslander--Reiten quiver #

    lem:mesh-walk-free (scalar-normalization.tex): the complex K of Γ_A has free vertex groups. The hypotheses of MeshWalk.isFreeGroup_end are Lemma 2.2 (at most one arrow, hasAtMostOneArrow) and the finite-dimensionality of k(Γ_A) (finiteDimensional_meshHom), which is what Proposition 4.1 needs. The source assumes A connected; the vertex group at every vertex is free without this assumption.
